name: aladin_deep_diagnosis_v0_2
rules: Choose one primary constraint unless a second is inseparable.
Preserve variables that are already working.
Do not fix an earlier stage if a later stage is the active economic constraint.
Make a best-available strategic bet when data is incomplete unless the action is high-risk or irreversible.
Name the second-most-likely constraint and explain why it loses.
Predict the next bottleneck and the signal that indicates the bottleneck has moved.
